name: Everval judge study 2026-10-27
cost_basis: Conservative upper bound: all input at 2.5x standard uncached input price, all output at standard price. This is not an invoice.
primary_endpoint: Human-vote agreement, equal question and equal retained-reviewer weighting.
selection: All six judge configurations are predeclared for holdout; development is compatibility/estimation, not winner selection.

power.human_primary: Fractional paired question-level difference; normal-approximation sensitivity over predeclared paired SDs 0.10, 0.25, 0.50 at n=64 and alpha=.05/3. Exact McNemar does not apply to this endpoint.
power.execution_secondary: 40 held-out tasks; binary task-level comparisons require one prespecified paired decision; repeated observations do not increase independent sample size.

publication_scope: Summary of a locally frozen pre-inference plan; raw requests and reference records remain private. This is not an externally registered preregistration.
hash_convention: plan_sha256 and request_sha256 use SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, non-ASCII preserved). protocol_sha256 hashes the approved file bytes.
